name: Curse of the Bloody Tome
text: Enchant player\nAt the beginning of enchanted player's upkeep, that player mills two cards.
flavor: After seeing his life's work drip away, the mage decided it was a good time to go crazy.
rulings: [{'date': '2011-09-22', 'text': 'If the enchanted player has only one card in their library, they put that card into their graveyard.'}]

name: Bloodcrazed Neonate
text: Bloodcrazed Neonate attacks each combat if able.\nWhenever Bloodcrazed Neonate deals combat damage to a player, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
flavor: While elder vampires select their meals with care, the newly sired frenzy at the first whiff.

name: Boneyard Wurm
text: Boneyard Wurm's power and toughness are each equal to the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
flavor: The only thing it likes more than discovering a pit of bones is adding to it.
rulings: [{'date': '2018-12-07', 'text': 'The ability that defines Boneyard Wurm’s power and toughness works in all zones, not just the battlefield. If Boneyard Wurm is in your graveyard, it will count itself.'}]
